actual queried full edges and retained programmatic chain

feasibility.gate: After all exact gates, one three-real-case AB100 screen; every case must reduce complete-call latency by >=5%. Any numerical/hash/ownership failure stops immediately. Failed aggregate screen stops without additional repetitions/service/stress timing.

formal_timing.requires: All exact and all three real >=5% first; report screen before additional frozen rounds

stop: First semantic/hash/ownership mismatch or timeout; preserve failures. No tolerance relaxation, source mutation during run, cache flushing, clock changes, runtime promotion or unapproved extra stages. On competitor only terminate own process.
baseline_comparison: Complete implementation A/B, not single-variable versus vendor. The isolated SF change is relative to the prior metadata-ready candidate; native baseline retains tactic8,5 and PDL.
timing_instrumentation: No extra debug export kernel or Python checks inside measured replay; normal working intermediates retain their original mathematical role. Only complete native metadata+FC1+activation+FC2+finalizer graphs are timed.
